submitted.rationale: EQE falls with Sb along the Fe-Sb line: Fe0.85Sb0.15 (idx 0) gave 0.369%, Fe0.49Sb0.51 (idx 12, rutile FeSbO4 region) gave only 0.0056%. Fe0.79Sb0.21 (idx 3) gave the highest value, 0.464%. XRD suggests this is a mixed hematite + FeSbO4-type region, where some Sb helps before the rutile phase takes over.

EQE drops steeply toward high Sb; not measured because the budget was limited
